## Summary

[Partial] Remove the shifter boot and secure the inner shaft before replacing the knob. [t1442]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. [Partial] Remove the shifter boot to expose the shaft.
2. Secure the inner shifter shaft using a sliding bar clamp or vice grips under the boot area.

_Procedure reported by [t1442]._

## Tools

- Sliding bar clamp [t1442]
- Vice grips (optional) [t1442]
- Channel lock pliers [t1442]

## Specifications

- **Knob thread size**: M10 x 1.25 [t1442] ([Unverified] single report)

## Tips & gotchas

- [Partial] Wrap the outer knob in a shop towel or dish rag to prevent scratching. [t1442]
- Use leverage by twisting with channel locks while holding the shaft steady. [t1442]

## Common mistakes

- [Partial] Cutting off the threaded insert inside the knob instead of unscrewing it. [t1442]
